title: carex lurida f. parvula
intro: Carex lurida f. parvula, commonly known as Japanese sedges, is a plant species in the family Cyperaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in wound healing, reducing pain and inflammation.
